text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5. The comment above it and the tests both say five.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned one event too many (`[-n - 1:]`). It now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the `Emma` book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. I made up the author, year and copy count, since the tests only check the title.
